narration.full_text: Namaste students! Today, we're diving into the fascinating world of control and coordination in living organisms. We'll explore how different systems work together to maintain balance and respond to changes around us. By the end of this lesson, you will be able to define control and coordination and identify the key systems involved. You'll also learn about the structure and function of the animal nervous system and neurons, and understand reflex actions and the reflex arc. Furthermore, we will identify the main parts and functions of the human brain, explore plant movements and the role of plant hormones, and describe the endocrine system and the function of animal hormones.
